Yes, we’re super excited to say we do ship internationally! Our beautiful custom jewellery can be delivered to so many places around the world.
For customs and duties, it depends on where you’re ordering from:
If you’re in the UK or most European countries, import taxes and duties are included in the price—so there are no extra charges when your order arrives.
For the USA, from 16 May 2025, a 30% tariff will apply to your purchase due to new government regulations. These charges are set by the US government and are the customer’s responsibility.
For the rest of the world, any customs charges are set by your local authorities and will need to be covered by you. We always recommend checking with your local Customs Office if you want to be sure about any extra fees.
